title: PlantGeo ML service — extract ML and Monte Carlo into a dedicated Parquet-fed service
description: Move method/ml and method/monte_carlo out of agri-data-service into services/plantgeo-ml-service: zero-Postgres, Parquet in and out, own API lane, Mojo kernels behind parity harnesses, fire-risk and spatial-KNN daily lanes. Code and plans only; training runs are owner-triggered later.

owner_decisions.forecast_partitions: the ML service writes kind=forecast; agri-data-service becomes observed-only
owner_decisions.mojo_shape: Python host, Mojo kernels imported from Python, each behind a golden-output parity harness
owner_decisions.first_slice: fire-risk occurrence AND spatial KNN (Analog Ensemble), both written daily to Parquet
owner_decisions.postgres: zero; expert label plane exported to Parquet once
owner_decisions.cutover: hard cut in one push; git history is the archive

owner_decisions.bookkeeping: supersedes ml_mojo_conversion_20260823; service owns its own RUNBOOK.md; one row in the main RUNBOOK
owner_decisions.training: OUT OF SCOPE — owner finalises data in a separate session
